headline: Hungarian Stock Exchange Soars at Opening, but Severe Shortage and Price Shock Threaten Motorists
summary: The Hungarian BUX index rose at the open, supported by all four domestic blue chips. A global engine oil shortage and price increases are adding cost burdens for companies.
why: The BUX is the benchmark index of the Budapest Stock Exchange, tracking Hungary's largest listed companies.
why_moved: Gains in all four domestic blue chips lifted the index at the open.
